items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf injury; Rams optimistic Saturday, Schefter/Rapoport confirm active.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; no setbacks; officially active for late window.
items.implication: Must-start WR1; full role expected despite limited/no practice Fri.
items.opportunity: High target share with Adams OUT; reverse any Mumpfield stash.

items.text: Breece Hall INACTIVE vs Dolphins (quad); Rapoport earlier said unlikely after limited practice and no full participation.
items.why: Not full participant yet returning from multi-week quad; early return attempt failed.
items.implication: Continue committee/lead for backup RBs; Hall delayed return.
items.opportunity: Jets RB handcuff/backup volume spike in favorable spot.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals (ankle/high-ankle). Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: ETR weekend summary and Schefter report of Ravens ruling him out after limited practice.
items.implication: Huntley start; Flowers/Andrews/Likely remain viable but lower ceiling without Lamar dual-threat.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass game volume to Zay Flowers and TEs; no Lamar rushing upside.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT for Monday Night vs Cowboys (hamstring); did not practice late week.
items.why: ETR summary and Rapoport/Eagles report confirming OUT; missed practices.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets redistribute; Pickens/Goedert elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for George Pickens and Dallas Goedert.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos backfield snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; JK Dobbins only 21% snaps. Berry reaffirms preseason love, roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: Snap/rush/route shares confirm Coleman takeover; Berry long-term belief.
items.implication: Coleman must-roster/add; Dobbins clear downgrade to committee/backup.
items.opportunity: Coleman lead RB opportunity ROS in Denver.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) per Levitan, though not certain; felt something on OT run, went down knowing FG range; bye helps.
items.why: Self-reported during career long run; ETR watching; severity unclear but real.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 8 after bye; possible limited or Tracy/others share.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Tracy or committee RBs rise; reverse full lead-back assumption.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide late in win; would have been tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.why: Purposeful slide mechanics; Levitan and video analysis (Chao) low force; post-game fine reports.
items.opportunity: Full workload intact; no Montgomery/others spike.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (shoulder/chest) exited late vs Cardinals after botched reverse/fumble recovery; did not return. Watching post-game.
items.why: Fell awkwardly recovering fumble; tent then locker; prior limited practices this week.
items.implication: Monitor severity for Week 8; possible miss or limited.
items.opportunity: If out, DEN WR depth (Sutton etc) rises; reverse full start.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT Monday vs Cowboys (ankle); paired with Smith OUT in ETR report.
items.why: Missed practices; confirmed OUT alongside Smith.
items.implication: Further thins Eagles WR depth; more work to remaining pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Boost to Pickens and TE usage in two-WR sets.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys (hamstring); questionable but Rapoport notes expected.
items.why: Limited practice but sources indicate return; ETR lists expected.
items.implication: RB1 workload if active; monitor final inactive.
items.opportunity: Full bellcow if cleared; reverse any Gainwell-only assumptions.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated and IN/expected to play for Packers after missing time.
items.why: Activated Saturday/Sunday; ETR lists IN; Rapoport notes return.
items.implication: Lead RB role resumes; monitor snap share post-layoff.
items.opportunity: High volume RB back; handcuffs drop.

items.text: Xavier Worthy led Chiefs WR routes 33 of 36 Mahomes dropbacks in 2nd game without Rashee Rice; never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games.
items.why: Route data post-Rice absence; high opportunity but historical ceiling note.
items.implication: Volume there but efficiency/ceiling questions; WR3/flex with caveats.
items.opportunity: Clear alpha routes without Rice; monitor targets conversion.
items.conflict: High routes vs career yd ceiling under 83.

items.text: Jets WR routes with AD Mitchell back (33 Geno dropbacks): Garrett Wilson 29, Omar Cooper 23, AD Mitchell 18. Cooper efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgts career-to-date limited routes.
items.why: Post-Mitchell return route shares; Cooper popping on limited work.
items.implication: Wilson still clear lead; Cooper deep sleeper efficiency.
items.opportunity: Wilson high routes; watch Cooper if volume grows.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad/thigh) and Kenny Gainwell (hip) both returned to their games after exiting; listed in Sunday injuries watching but cleared in-game.
items.why: In-game returns confirmed; no lasting issue apparent.
items.implication: No lingering for Week 8; full roles intact.
items.opportunity: CMC bellcow continues; Gainwell handcuff/change-of-pace ok.
